title: fix(discord): resolve known mentions before sentence-ending periods
body:
Fixes #172188

## What Problem This Solves

Discord bot and thread-bound persona replies leave known aliases such as `@alice.` and `@alice.dev...` as literal text, so the intended recipient is not mentioned.

## User Impact

Known aliases resolve before sentence punctuation while preserving that punctuation. Dotted usernames and exact known handles ending in periods retain longest-known-match precedence. Mentions immediately after Markdown links resolve, while URL contents, email addresses, code spans and backtick fences, unknown handles, and reserved broadcasts remain literal. No configuration changes or migration are required.

## Why This Change Was Made

The existing mention owner captures periods as part of a handle. It now tries the full handle, then removes only trailing periods until the longest known handle resolves. Configured aliases still precede the account-scoped directory for each candidate.

URL protection uses the existing Discord Markdown URL-range scanner, extracted into a small shared module. It preserves balanced parentheses inside URLs, stops at unmatched closing parentheses, and leaves trailing sentence punctuation outside the URL. The original mention tokenizer scans prose around these ranges; the greedy URL alternative has been removed. This fixes ClawSweeper's concrete P2 for `See [docs](https://example.com),@alice` without adding a second mention parser or loading the Markdown parser into mention resolution.

Original fix by @fhgffy; maintainer cleanup consolidates regressions, reuses existing transport cases, corrects URL boundaries, and shares their existing owner.

## Evidence

Source and history confirm the defect on fresh main `693fcc412fdffb879c9523eace19eac55e651909`, fetched by URL and merged before this repair. Main was refreshed again and merged at `9e3e16c224697b9a5cb24e7ede12ac4992a97a87` immediately before push; all seven reviewed files are unchanged by that merge. There is no competing fix for the linked issue.

PR CI is the test gate per Peter's explicit task instruction: “relax testing and trust PR CI, just lint.” Local unit tests, typechecks, negative controls, and live Gateway/Discord proof were intentionally skipped; no Crabbox/Testbox lease was created. ClawSweeper's full exact-head review on `4d7e543b2c7440d26ff8de12a52a5a6c15c96ed8` confirms the earlier URL-boundary P2 is fixed and reports no concrete code findings. Its sole remaining item is the live-proof request, superseded by that instruction.

The existing `resolves prose mentions while preserving URLs and emails: %s` regression table includes:

- `See [docs](https://example.com),@alice` → the alias becomes a native mention.
- `(https://example.com/a_(b)) @alice.` → balanced URL parentheses survive and prose resolves with its period.
- `https://example.com/@alice` → unchanged.
- `user@alice.com` → unchanged, even with `alice.com` configured.
- A mention inside balanced URL parentheses followed by a mention after the Markdown destination; only the latter resolves.

The other focused regressions cover sentence punctuation, dotted/discriminator handles, longest-known matches, reserved broadcasts, code protection, account-scoped normal sends, and persona-webhook delivery. CI also covers the existing Discord Markdown rendering tests and applicable lint/typecheck/boundary checks. No sleeps, timers, or additional transport-server boots were added; current test timing comes from CI.

Changed-file syntax lint, oxfmt, and `git diff --check` passed. The temporary lint config preserves all rules applicable to the changed TypeScript files and omits only the unrelated UI TSX plugin override, whose dependency is absent from the shared install. No dependency install was performed. Canonical Codex branch autoreview, including full renderer/tokenizer/scanner source, is scoped-clean through P2 on `00c117f7011d`. The subsequent main merge preserves the reviewed files. Exact-head [CI run 38693001648](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/38693001648), attempt 1, completed with 26 successful jobs, two failing checks, and a red aggregate gate. Its changed-extension job passed 223 Discord tests across 13 files in 54.66 seconds, including every requested regression, existing Markdown rendering tests, the account-scoped bot case, and persona-webhook delivery. The adjacent-link case took 9 ms; the other requested rows took 1 ms each. The other changed-node test jobs also passed. Production and test typechecks both passed.

Production: +57/-43 (net +14); tests: +65/-15 (net +50); docs: +3/-1 (net +2). Most of the URL scanner diff is a move; the remaining production growth adds bounded trailing-dot lookup and shares URL protection between the two consumers. No deferred effects, public API/configuration changes, or schema changes are introduced.

The final run has two unrelated failures: [check-docs/job 116283442872](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/38693001648/job/116283442872) reports formatting in `ui/src/components/wizard-step-controls.ts` and `ui/src/pages/chat/components/chat-picker-overlay.test.ts`; [check-lint-core-4/job 116283864008](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/38693001648/job/116283864008) reports `typescript/no-generated-empty-object-type` at `chat-composer-types.ts:161` and `chat-pane-session-controls.ts:140`. All four files are byte-identical to the merged main revision and outside this PR's diff. The docs content checks themselves passed. Main subsequently fixed the two formatting issues in [d08cd455ce1c](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/commit/d08cd455ce1c6370bb4d0e547b7157120b946d52); that later commit is not included in this tested PR head. The UI lint errors remain outside this repair.

Latest scheduled-main run [38687324602](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/38687324602), attempt 2 (overall run cancelled) at older head `c58d6181af08cbd56ad42466d03295145d94068b`, passed both corresponding jobs ([docs 116279209111](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/38687324602/job/116279209111), [lint 116279213295](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/38687324602/job/116279213295)). These PR failures therefore are not claimed as matching scheduled-main inherited failures. The Discord repair is verified by CI; the overall CI gate still requires the unrelated UI failures to be resolved or handled by the landing coordinator.
